newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Verbund to start ADR-programme.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Verbund to start ADR-programme.

text.p: Austrian grid company Verbundgesellschaft said on Monday it would launch an ADR-programme in New York and would also change its accounting system to bring it in line with international standards.
"We will start an ADR-programme by the end of February in order to meet the needs of investors in the United States", Verbund Chief Financial Officer Michael Pistauer told a news conference.
Verbund was also poised to switch to the International Accounting Standard (IAS) in 1997, Pistauer said, adding that the company wanted to raise transparency for international investors.
